explanation: Generated a single EXCLURAD eta-channel input file covering the full 3x3 W x Q2 grid (W = 1.55, 1.65, 1.75 GeV; Q2 = 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 GeV^2), all 9 points at cos(theta*) = 0 and phi* = 90 deg. All points lie well above the eta-photoproduction threshold W_thr = m_p + m_eta ~= 1.487 GeV (using m_p = 0.9383 GeV, m_eta = 0.5488 GeV as coded in exclurad.F), and within the EtaMAID-2023 hadronic table's coverage (W up to 6 GeV, Q2 up to 5 GeV^2 per mpintp.inc), so the grid is physically valid with no kinematic correction required. Used the standard eta-channel defaults from the template: model=3 (maid2000/EtaMAID), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) correction), bmom=6.53 GeV (CLAS12 beam), lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (detected recoil proton), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (CLAS12 inelasticity cut). 9 points fit in a single input file (well under the code's npoimax=10000 array limit).
